tasks.name: Events gold: FPP + sledcom + personnel (72)
tasks.description: Built 2026-09-10. Three interleaved silver-audit calibration tasks in one chunk, each a single fast factual yes/no/unclear question with the decision rule never shown: (1) fpp (30) -- a trimmed subset (15 referee-disagreement + 8 possible-false-positive + 7 possible-false-negative) of the fpp-primary-type-gold v3 chunk's own already-flagged pools, calibrating the arrest_legal/governor_political boundary that drives the arrests paper's treatment coding. (2) sledcom (20) -- 10 referee-split + 6 confirmed-NOT-official + 4 confirmed-official rows from the 773-row involves_official-alone census (notes/sledcom_773_adjudication_2026-09-09.md), directly checking whether Noah endorses dropping the proposed 497-row slice from arrests_master. (3) personnel (15) -- 8 silver-says-not-a-change + 4 referee-split + 3 confirmed-change rows from the rusclf personnel silver sample, checking the 60.5%-precision finding that gates a $150-300 Haiku re-do decision for elitesData. 65 base items + 7 silent repeats = 72, interleaved with a fixed seed (not blocked by task), repeats kept >= 8 positions from their original. Loader (eventsData/code/99g_load_events_gold_mixed.R) scores each task SEPARATELY against its own referees/silver/production label and refuses to print any pooled or population accuracy number -- this is a deliberately targeted, non-representative sample. See START_HERE_2026-09-10.md for what each section decides.

tasks.name: Campaign relevance GATE — is this a campaign/political message? (~100)
tasks.description: PRIORITY 1. Direct binary gold for the is-campaign gate — unlocks a free local classifier to replace the ~$300-1,500 Haiku relevance run. Balanced 50/50, boundary-oversampled. Judge from the text.

tasks.name: Sentiment — 3-class, 5-model check (~100)
tasks.description: PRIORITY 2. Anchors RuBERT-tiny2 accuracy + its neutral-over-prediction bias (the standing publication blocker). ~75 model-disagreement rows + ~25 all-agree anchor.

tasks.name: Channel actor-type — confirm/correct (110)
tasks.description: PRIORITY 3. rusclf v3 gold. The username rule mislabels regional NEWS channels as party/ER — your corrections are the ONLY clean news/not_political negatives. Code the negatives deliberately.

tasks.name: Court decision extraction — confirm/correct (120)
tasks.description: PRIORITY 4. First-ever gold for court-decision extraction (verdict/sentence/fine/articles). Feeds a rusclf v3 court slice → then the full 122K corpus runs $0 local.

tasks.name: Blame attribution — BLIND (81)
tasks.description: PRIORITY 5. Does a disaster post attribute responsibility, to whom, how strongly + futility? No Haiku shown (unbiased κ). Unblocks the disaster paper's per-event blame consumption.

tasks.name: Disaster D-31 — stated-date validation (~60)
tasks.description: Validate the LLM-extracted stated_event_date on file for llm_stated_date-sourced events (all currently day_high confidence, zero external check). Stratified by the extraction's own confidence (low/medium/high) and spread across 2012-2022. Feeds the per-source accuracy check in audit_2026-05-13.md:220 -- drop sources below ~70% accuracy. Built 2026-09-05.

tasks.name: Arrests LLM-only precision (100)
tasks.description: First-ever precision check on the LLM-only arrests (2026-05-07 audit item 3): 8,652 FPP-LLM-only arrests plus the entirely-unhand-coded Telegram/Shkulev/Sledcom sources. 25 per source, spread across crime_type. Feeds an honest precision % with a Wilson CI (loader: eventsData/code/99d_load_llm_only_precision_results.R, to be run after export). Built 2026-09-05.

tasks.name: FPP primary_type gold (67, v3) -- SUPERSEDED by events-gold-mixed
tasks.description: v3 (2026-09-09 SHRINK). Replaces the 170-item v2 chunk (preserved as items_170.json.bak/schema_170.json.bak) with 60 boundary items + 7 silent repeats (67 total), per Noah's call: v2 spent most of its budget re-confirming cases two independent silver referees (Claude Opus 5, gpt-5) already agree on. 30 items are drawn from the 59-event referee-DISAGREEMENT set (restricted to the 46 that bear on the arrest_legal/governor_political boundary), 15 are silver-agreed arrest_legal events flagged as possible FALSE POSITIVES (removal/resignation arrest_stage, and/or haiku_v2/nano_low_v2 dissent), 15 are silver-agreed governor_political events flagged as possible FALSE NEGATIVES (haiku_v2/nano_low_v1/v2 dissent, and/or a legal-predicate cue word in the text). Every item asks the SAME factual binary question (does the text state a legal predicate?) -- the 9-way typology variant from v2 is dropped since every item is now a boundary item. Loader (eventsData/code/99f_load_primary_type_gold60_results.R) reports, separately: referee-disagreement agreement per referee, false-positive vs false-negative confirmation rates (NOT pooled -- a silver error rate means something different in each direction), every model arm vs Noah, and Noah's own test-retest from the repeats. This is a deliberately boundary-only, non-representative sample -- NOT used for population/corpus accuracy; the loader refuses to print a pooled corpus-accuracy number.
